duplicate-ticket-ranker.ts asks one independent `noul` question per candidate, then orders them in code with `scored.sort((a, b) => b.probability - a.probability || a.index - b.index)`; the model never outputs an ordering.

The code always returns every candidate ranked, with no merge threshold and no 'none' option, so nothing handles the case where no candidate is a duplicate; the final message only says thresholds 'should be calibrated,' and the only early return is `if (candidates.length === 0) return [];`, which covers an empty input rather than no duplicate.
